description: Straßenbenennung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cloud.goettingen.de. Origin of street names in the city of Göttingen. With the naming of streets after women or men, well-known personalities are honored. They often have a connection to Göttingen. For all roads (including impersonal ones), the origin of the name and the date of dedication is described. The information is stored in a point. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Road name" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Etymologie, Straßenbenennung, TRAN, opendata, Widmung. The listing shows 2025-10-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
